foryou.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
foryou.summary: Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns to finish what was previously started, Jake must work with Neytiri and the army of the Na'vi race to protect their home.

foryou.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
foryou.summary: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence.

foryou.title: Interstellar
foryou.summary: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.

foryou.title: Top Gun: Maverick
foryou.summary: After thirty years, Maverick is still pushing the envelope as a top naval aviator, but must confront ghosts of his past when he leads TOP GUN's elite graduates on an impossible mission.

foryou.title: The Batman
foryou.summary: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

foryou.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
foryou.summary: With Spider-Man's identity now revealed, Peter asks Doctor Strange for help. When a spell goes wrong, dangerous foes from other worlds start to appear, forcing Peter to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

foryou.title: Oppenheimer
foryou.summary: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

foryou.title: Dune
foryou.summary: A noble family becomes embroiled in a war for control over the galaxy's most valuable asset while its heir becomes troubled by visions of a dark future.

comedy.summary: A bank teller discovers that he's actually an NPC inside a brutal, open world video game and decides to become the hero of his own story.
